definitions.scope: campaigns with 100 or more contestants, ordinary: finance_crypto organizers and the crypto, ambiguous and purchase-opportunity segments of the earlier classification excluded
definitions.conversion: contestants per impression, all campaigns; the clean group has no repeatable action and 14 days or less. groups.all and groups.clean carry separate conversion arrays, so rank a campaign against the group its run length and actions place it in.
definitions.actions_per_contestant: completed actions divided by contestants, entry_count is completions
definitions.vertical: homepage-label industry folded into the ten vertical names review.py accepts
definitions.industry: homepage-label industry, one group per label with five organizers
definitions.per_action_uptake: completions per contestant for campaigns offering the action, by Gleam action name
definitions.stated_usd_per_contestant: stated prize pool in USD at fixed rates divided by contestants, campaigns with every prize valued
definitions.stated_usd_pool: stated prize pool in USD at fixed rates, campaigns with every prize valued
definitions.bench: the summary block review.py prints as the benchmark median: quartiles of the all group, conversion by method count on the clean subset and by run length on campaigns without a repeatable action, completions per contestant by action family, median email signups and referral entries by band
